title: RM Store Specialist
tagsAndSkills: GRN,Stores,Store Keeping,SAP,Inventory Management,Management,RM,Inventory
jobDescription:
Position Overview:

The RM Store Specialist will be responsible for managing, monitoring, and controlling raw material inventory in compliance with organizational and regulatory standards. The role ensures the timely availability of raw materials, accurate record keeping, and adherence to safety and quality standards.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage day-to-day operations of the raw material store including receipt, storage, issuance, and record maintenance.
  • Ensure all raw materials are properly labeled, identified, and stored as per SOPs and regulatory requirements.
  • Conduct regular stock verification, cycle counts, and reconciliation of physical vs. system stock.
  • Coordinate with Procurement, Production, and Quality teams to ensure timely availability of raw materials without disruption.
  • Maintain FIFO/FEFO system for material issuance.
  • Monitor storage conditions (temperature, humidity, cleanliness) to maintain material quality.
  • Ensure compliance with ISO, GMP, and other regulatory requirements for raw material handling.
  • Manage documentation including GRNs, stock registers, bin cards, and SAP/ERP entries.
  • Identify slow-moving, non-moving, or expired raw materials and coordinate for proper disposal as per guidelines.
  • Support audits (internal/external) by ensuring documentation accuracy and store readiness.
  • Train and supervise store assistants/handlers on material handling, safety, and SOP adherence.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Graduate/Diploma in Supply Chain/Logistics/Science/Commerce or related field.
  • Minimum 3+ years of experience in raw material store management (preferably in pharmaceuticals/medical devices/ manufacturing industry).
  • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP/Oracle/Tally or equivalent).
  • Knowledge of inventory management techniques (FIFO, FEFO, JIT).
  • Strong understanding of ISO 13485, GMP, and regulatory compliance related to raw material handling.

Skills Required:

  • Excellent knowledge of inventory management and material control.
  • Strong documentation and record-keeping skills.
  • Good coordination and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage a team of store assistants and handlers.
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word) and ERP systems.
  • Attention to detail and problem-solving ability.

title: Engineer - Methoding & Simulation

jobDescription:
Position: Methoding & Simulation Engineer

Experience: Min 5yrs & above

Industry: Foundry / Casting (Ferrous )

Reports To: Foundry Head

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Methoding & Simulation Engineer with strong experience in foundry methoding, casting simulation, and process optimization. The candidate will be responsible for designing gating and risering systems, preparing casting drawings with allowances, and performing casting simulation using advanced software tools to ensure defect-free, cost-effective castings.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop methoding layouts (gating & risering) for new and existing castings.
  • Prepare 2D and 3D casting drawings/models by applying contraction, machining, and draft allowances for use in simulation software.
  • Perform solidification and flow simulations using industry-standard software (e.g., MAGMASOFT, ProCAST, AutoCAST, or equivalent).
  • Optimize casting design for yield improvement, quality enhancement, and cost reduction.
  • Analyze simulation results to identify potential defects (shrinkage, porosity, inclusions, misruns, etc.) and propose corrective actions.
  • Work closely with Pattern, production and other teams to finalize casting designs and ensure manufacturability.
  • Support production trials, troubleshoot casting issues, and provide technical guidance on corrective actions.
  • Maintain simulation database, prepare technical documentation, and standardize methoding practices.
  • Ensure compliance with quality standards, customer specifications, and foundry best practices.
  • Provide technical support in customer discussions, design reviews, and new product development (NPD) activities.



Preferred candidate profile


Required Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of foundry processes (sand casting,)
  • Hands-on experience with casting simulation software (MAGMASOFT, ProCAST, AutoCAST or equivalent)
  • Proficiency in 2D CAD software (AutoCAD, or equivalent)
  • Ability to apply casting allowances (contraction, machining, draft, distortion) in drawing preparation
  • Deep understanding of metallurgy, solidification principles, and defect mechanisms
  • Proficiency in 3D CAD tools (SolidWorks, CATIA, Pro e or equivalent)
  • Ability to interpret customer drawings, QAP, and technical specifications
  • Good communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

Experience & Qualifications

  • B.E./B.Tech in Metallurgical, Mechanical, Production, or Foundry Engineering.
  • 58 years of experience in reputed foundries with proven track record in methoding and casting simulation.
  • Exposure to development of critical/complex castings for energy, or heavy engineering sectors preferred.
  • Experience in defect analysis and root cause problem-solving.

We are looking for a hands-on Machine Learning Advisor who can both build initial models and mentor our junior engineers as they refine and productionize them. This is a part-time role designed for a senior professional who enjoys rolling up their sleeves to prototype and code, while also providing strategic guidance, architecture oversight, and mentorship.You will help us establish a solid ML foundation by:

  • Building and validating the first versions of our models.
  • Setting up the right processes, frameworks, and best practices.
  • Working closely with junior team members to fine-tune, scale, and optimize models.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a builder + advisor hybrid capacity, balancing hands-on contributions with leadership and mentorship.

jobDescription:
Job Title: NMS/OSS Solution Delivery Engineer

Location: Hyderabad

Job Type: Full-Time

Department: Technology Services

Reports To: NMS/OSS Solution Architect

Job Summary:

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced NMS/OSS Solution Delivery Engineer with 6 to 12 years of experience in deploying and supporting network management and OSS solutions in customer-facing environments. The ideal candidate will play a key role in solution delivery, SLA management, documentation, and design optimization, working closely with senior architects to ensure successful implementation and continuous improvement of NMS/EMS/OSS platforms.

Key Responsibilities:

Solution Delivery & Deployment:

  • Lead or support on-site and remote deployments of NMS/EMS/OSS platforms across telecom, enterprise, and government networks.
  • Act as a technical point of contact for customers during deployment and post-deployment phases.
  • Ensure timely and quality delivery of solutions in line with project timelines and SLAs.

Design Support & Optimization:

  • Assist senior architects in reviewing and refining High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs).
  • Provide feedback and suggestions for design improvements based on field experience and customer feedback.
  • Participate in solution validation, testing, and optimization activities.

SLA Management & Reporting:

  • Monitor solution performance and support SLA tracking and compliance.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to identify and resolve SLA breaches or performance issues.
  • Generate and present SLA and performance reports to internal and external stakeholders.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer:

  • Prepare and maintain deployment guides, as-built documentation, and customer-facing manuals.
  • Support knowledge transfer sessions and training for customer operations teams.

Collaboration & Support:

  • Work closely with senior solution architects, project managers, and customer teams to ensure alignment and smooth delivery.
  • Provide technical support during UAT, go-live, and stabilization phases.

Required Technical Skills:

  • 612 years of experience in NMS/EMS/OSS deployment and support.
  • Hands-on experience with platforms such as OpenText NNM/NoM, Zabbix, Cisco Prime, Netcool, or similar.
  • Understanding of North-Bound and South-Bound integrations (SNMP, REST, SOAP, XML/JSON).
  • Exposure to ITOM and ITIL processes, especially incident, change, and problem management.
  • Experience with ticketing platforms (ServiceNow, SMAX, Remedy, JIRA).
  • Proficiency in scripting (Python, Shell, Perl) and basic database management (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle).
  • Familiarity with network technologies (IP/MPLS, LTE/5G, SD-WAN, DWDM).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (IT, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or related field).
  • Certifications or training in ITIL, ServiceNow, or relevant OSS/NMS platforms.
  • Experience in customer-facing roles and solution delivery in telecom or enterprise environments.

Work Environment:

  • On-Site work model with occasional travel to client sites.
  • Collaborative and delivery-focused environment with opportunities to grow into a senior architect role.

Job Purpose:

The Senior Finance Manager will play a pivotal role in overseeing the financial management of HTIC Globals insurance brokering operations in the UAE.   • Audit & Regulatory Compliance: Manage internal and external audits, ensuring compliance with regulatory frameworks and financial standards.
  • Team Management: Supervise and mentor the finance team to ensure high performance and continuous professional development.

jobDescription:
In this role, you will:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

The Senior Finance Manager will play a pivotal role in overseeing the financial management of HTIC Globals insurance brokering operations in the UAE. LSEG is the leading provider of news and financial information in the world. On its own, the value of its data is significant, but usability and insights are significantly enhanced based on the way we organize and arrange our data in order to make it understandable and discoverable.

The LSEG Data Model standardizes the concepts our data represents. For these reasons, utilization of connected datasets results in a significant competitive advantage.

  • Good understanding of financial reference and/or market reference data.

  • Understanding of UML and ERD for logical data models is essential for this role
  • Understanding of RDBMSs and proficiency with SQL
  • Experience of Sparx Systems Enterprise Architect, or other visual data modelling tools desirable but not essential
  • Understanding of JSON and/or XML essential

jobDescription:
We are looking for a Stone Crusher and Mining Supervisor to oversee the operations of a quarry and crushing plant, focusing on safety, productivity, and compliance, by managing crew schedules, coordinating stone extraction and delivery, ensuring crusher and machinery maintenance, and conducting safety inspections. Key responsibilities include managing resources, leading teams, and resolving operational issues to meet production targets and maintain equipment.


Key Responsibilities

Production Management: Oversee stone extraction from the quarry and manage the crushing process to produce aggregates (like gravel and sand) according to production targets.


Crew Supervision: Schedule and manage mining and crushing crews, providing direct oversight, coordination, and support to ensure efficient operation during their shift.


Safety and Compliance: Enforce safety protocols and regulations, conduct safety inspections, and ensure all activities adhere to statutory requirements.


Equipment Maintenance: Accountable for the maintenance and repair of crushers, heavy machinery, and other equipment to prevent breakdowns and ensure operational efficiency.


Logistics and Coordination: Coordinate with the mining team for the timely delivery of boulders to the crusher and manage the dispatch and delivery of crushed materials to customers.


Resource Management: Effectively manage men, machinery, and spare parts to optimize the profitability of the operation.


Reporting and Communication: Maintain logs, report incidents, and communicate clearly between ground crews and management.


Required Skills and Qualifications


Experience: Proven hands-on experience in hard stone crushers and mining operations.

jobDescription:
Job Summary

We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Quality Control Engineer with a

background in Chemical Engineering and specific expertise in concrete admixtures. The

successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that our raw materials, in-process

materials, and finished admixture products meet the established quality standards and

specifications. This role is critical in maintaining our reputation for excellence and reliability in

incoming raw materials and outgoing finished admixture products to ensure they

meet the company's quality parameters and relevant industry standards (e.g., IS,

manufacturing process, implementing corrective actions as necessary to address any

deviations from the standard.

• Product Performance Analysis: Perform various tests on admixture products,

including but not limited to, setting time, compressive strength, and workability of

concrete.

• Documentation and Reporting: Maintain accurate and detailed records of all quality

control tests and analyses. Prepare certificates of analysis (COA) for finished

products and generate regular quality reports for management.

• Non-Conformance Management: Identify and document any non-conforming

materials or products. Work with the production team to investigate the root cause

• Calibration and Maintenance: Ensure that all laboratory equipment is properly

calibrated, maintained, and in good working order.

customer complaints related to product quality, providing technical support and

analysis as required.

• Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE): Adhere to all company safety procedures

and guidelines within the laboratory and plant to ensure a safe working environment.

• Continuous Improvement: Participate in and contribute to continuous improvement

initiatives to enhance quality control processes, test methods, and product quality.

admixtures.

Company Overview

Bar Code India is a place where extraordinary people gravitate in order to do their best work.

Together, we craft customized solutions and experiences people once couldnt have imagined and now cant imagine living without! If youre excited by the idea of making a real impact and joining a team where we pride ourselves on being one of the most diverse and inclusive companies in the country, a career with BCI might be your dream job.


Job Summary

As a Senior Sales Executive at Bar Code India, you will act as a vital link between customer needsand our cutting-edge AIDC (Automatic Identification and Data Capture) solutions. Your role will involve pre- and post-sales engagement, technical consultation, solution presentations, and driving hardware & Software sales including barcode scanners, printers, RFID systems, and associated software.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the sales team to understand client needs and recommend customized

solutions involving barcode scanners, printers, RFID hardware, and software.

  • Deliver engaging product demonstrations and presentations, simplifying technical features for decision-makers.
  • Provide technical support throughout the sales cycle, including system integration guidance and post-sales troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships, identifying opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and long-term partnerships.
  • Prepare technical proposals and respond to RFPs, contributing to successful contract closures.
  • Communicate customer feedback to product and service teams to influence future

enhancements.

  • Stay updated on industry trends, competitor offerings, and emerging technologies in

barcode and RFID.

  • Achieve individual sales targets and contribute to regional business development efforts.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field.
  • 25 years of experience in Senior Sales Executive, technical sales, or solution sales within the AIDC, barcode, RFID, or Pharma sector.
  • Hands-on knowledge of barcode technologies, RFID systems, industrial printers/scanners,

and related software.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Customer-focused attitude and strong problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to travel locally and regionally for client meetings and demos.

Preferred Skills

  • Familiarity with ERP, WMS, or inventory management system integration.
  • Health insurance coverage.
  • Understanding of barcode symbologies, RFID protocols, and industry standards.
  • Experience with CRM tools and sales enablement platforms.
  • Exposure to automation systems, including machine vision cameras and IoT-based solutions is a strong plus.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package with performance-linked incentives.
  • Health insurance and wellness benefits.
  • Structured training programs and career advancement opportunities.
  • Collaborative and inclusive work culture focused on innovation and growth.
  • Opportunity to work with top brands and cutting-edge AIDC technologies.

About Bar Code India

Welcome to the extraordinary world of Bar Code India (BCI), where weve been leading the

revolution in supply chain technologies across India for over two decades. Our mission is to

empower businesses to achieve excellence in visibility, efficiency, and intelligence through smart AIDC solutions. With marquee clients such as Flipkart, Cipla, FedEx, Unilever, Colgate, Ikea, Sony, and Hero, BCI is at the forefront of digital transformation in the retail, logistics, and manufacturing sectors. Our team of 250+ professionals, spread across 7 locations, is united by a shared passion for innovation, inclusion, and impact.
